name: multi-reward-bench
description: A benchmark that aggregates multiple reward signals to evaluate and compare language model responses under different reward functions. It measures how models rank and prefer responses when judged by a suite of reward models, and is intended for research into multi-objective or ensemble reward-based evaluation. The benchmark supports pairwise comparison, ranking, and composite scoring across reward sources.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset used in experiments on reward-models and RLHF; modest adoption in research prototypes.
